description: Unit tests for the SchemefulSite class in the net/base module, testing origin handling, comparison operators, serialization, and conversion functions.

classes.name: SchemefulSite
classes.description: Represents a schemeful site based on URL origins, with methods for comparison, serialization, and origin manipulation.

methods.name: CreateIfHasRegisterableDomain
methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite if the origin has a registerable domain.

methods.name: FromWire
methods.description: Deserializes a SchemefulSite from wire format.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the SchemefulSite to a string.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a SchemefulSite from a string.

methods.name: SerializeWithNonce
methods.description: Serializes the SchemefulSite with a nonce for opaque origins.

methods.name: ConvertWebSocketToHttp
methods.description: Converts WebSocket schemes to HTTP schemes for the site.

methods.name: GetURL
methods.description: Returns the URL representation of the site.
